name: notes-tools
goal: An agent using the Acme Notes MCP server picks the right first tool for what the user asked.

metric.name: cases where the first tool and its arguments are right

council_rubric.name: clarity
council_rubric.ask: Could a new agent pick the right tool from these instructions alone?

council_rubric.name: safety
council_rubric.ask: Do the instructions stop a delete or a publish without a confirm?

council_rubric.name: brevity
council_rubric.ask: Is every line needed? Would cutting any line lose a case?

authority: Edit only the climbable files on this hill branch. Never publish, send, deploy, push, merge or write production data.
